impact: Cheaper oil and firm European risk appetite support the global rebound into US CPI, a mild tailwind for chip and AI holdings.
summary: The Stoxx 600 rose about 0.9% by 08:05 GMT Tuesday, near its record, as oil fell after Trump played down the need for military action on Iran. Infineon gained 3.1% and K+S 2.3% on earnings; Lufthansa and Air France-KLM rose.
title: Stoxx 600 near record, up 0.9%; Infineon up 3% as oil slides
